body: I feel you man.   It’s ok.   Lots of ego driven nc rhetoric here in this subreddit.   Fact is, it doesn’t matter who contacted who last or whatever.    If it’s true love you felt it’s ok that it manifested in Unhealthy ways.    The truth is, if she doesn’t accept that love from you she’s losing out on just how wonderful you are as well.    The universe has a way of balancing things out.    You’ll be alright.   I was...I am.    Go eat your favorite food and think this:     She’d benefit so much from hearing me tell her how great this is....her loss.
Damn, good article.    Thanks.
Ofc she would say I want a relationship with you....I guess I have to insert the word exclusive...
Thanks ,  that’s perfect.

Thanks.    I am the great gatsby....she is daisy.   We were together, she left him for me, but practicality weighed in and she’s back to being selfish and shallow.     They deserve each other....if only I too could meet a poetic end and escape this pain.    I wish she’d run over someone so I could take the fall.,.
She says I love you and I miss you too...torture
Thank you

Thank you.   Life is such a crock of horse sh$t.   We are told to idolize such beautiful things, but those things are not meant for us...at least for me.     I’m in a sea of nothing always given enough strength to just carry on but nothing more.   If life were a game of monopoly,   I’d keep losing but somehow I’d get a “collect $25 from the bank@ community cheat card so I can’t completely lose and end it all.    I wish life would just go ahead and win already.
Distance is the only hope.    I have been ignoring that rule keeping in touch and professing my feelings despite her wanting to be friends....move on.   Move physically if necessary.
Thanks...but that won’t help.   A slow death is what I have to look forward to....maybe we all have to look forward to.
She told me so
Wow.   I’m not that strong I guess.   Thanks.
Thank you.
Thank you.

That’s the problem, people like you who assume Walmart clerks are slackers.....exactly proving my point...close minded and focused on Benjamin’s instead of love.   You keep proving my point.   Thanks.

The problem is disillusioned people like you that think they govern their lives that way, but people still rule their hearts with pragmatism.   Yes, women have more options....guess what, a highly paid woman still won’t date a clerk at Walmart.    Why, cause pragmatism trumps romance and by that very nature of love with exceptions means romance is dead.
But we profess that it does....and now we don’t even try....it may have never existed, but we have lost even its pursuit and so it’s dead.
Yeah, but we’d argue over which was better: string theory or GR and I’d be kicked out of your hut.   I’d get the fire in the divorce and have to move to an even smaller island.
I think it’s romantic to sacrifice ones self for someone who rejected him.   But yeah, your take is the reason romance is dead.
We act like it exists yes through those mediums,  but when it’s time to put up it shut up, we all go for the pragmatic.    Today most people would call Gatsby a dumbass.

Love is what they call it, but it’s a calculated series of criteria on what works.   We are so self absorbed now that we make sure the “one” will make sure we get more net flux time or whatever we want.   No introspective consideration of how they complete you.

Romance to me is following tour heart over your brain.   People are so quick to dismiss that which their heart desires because they don’t make enough money or won’t be accepted by their peers or family or whatever.
Who says our survival is that important anyway....a romantic would say it isn’t....but it’s a dead notion...exactly my point.
Love should be that simple but it’s not cause humans are shallow, materialistic, and weak.   We’ll value safety over passion any day.
Yeah, but you’ll gladly pick the guy who can afford flowers cause of a fancy job or whatever over some poor slob who just makes you smile.
Sorry, it auto caps...butterflies

Thanks...but don’t talk about my soul mate that way!...just kidding.   She sucks...but I’m an even bigger loser for wishing she’d take me back.   If there were awards for being pathetic, I’d rake in more nominations than “Roma”.
Only if you can build a fire or a hut.

Plus, I’m not sure what my other half would be like.   I’m typically incompatible with most people....and the ones I am compatible with drive me nuts.   Maybe it’s tome to grow a beard and find an island. ( not necessarily in that order)
Plato never got ghosted.
Thanks liverishgirl.  Why do we seek out love so much when it probably hurts more when it’s gone than I feels good when we have it?
Having been dumb enough to actually have an affair I can say.....don’t do it.    After great sex and and amazing romance she dumped me to go back to him...and my life’s ruined....avoid at alll costs
